payout_quote: For a limited time get $100 for you, and $100 for anyone you refer to Cal Coast Credit Union. ... Limited-time 2x Rewards (earn double the standard $50 incentive): Available for a limited time. ... Bonus limits: a) $100 max referral bonus per referred member, b) $500 max total referral bonuses per calendar year.
steps: Be an existing, active Cal Coast Credit Union member in good standing (18+).
Refer a friend to Cal Coast Credit Union; they must be a new member, open a separate membership account, and pay the one-time $5 membership fee.

The referred member opens a savings account and a checking account with eStatements, maintains at least a $50 balance in either account until the bonus is paid, and enrolls in Digital Banking, Bill Pay, or Direct Deposit.
You receive the $100 referral bonus per referred member (limited-time 2x of the standard $50), paid to your savings account within 3 business days after qualifications are met.
catches: The $100 is a LIMITED-TIME 2x boost (double the standard $50) that may end at any time once referral bonus funds are exhausted - the standard rate is $50.
Cap: $100 max per referred member; $500 max total referral bonuses per calendar year.
The friend must open and maintain accounts with a $50 balance and enroll in digital banking/Bill Pay/direct deposit - savings-only or inactive signups don't pay.
Referrals subject to verification; misuse can disqualify related individuals from all or part of the bonus.
Cannot be combined with any other offer; branch employees not eligible; referring members must be 18+.
Bonus reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: The $100 rate is a limited-time double of the standard $50 and can end anytime - and you're capped at $500 in referral bonuses per calendar year.
eligibility: Existing active Cal Coast CU members in good standing, 18+. Referred persons must be new members 13+ (13-15 needs a parent/guardian joint owner).
timing: Referral bonuses paid to the savings account within 3 business days after qualifications are met.
